source_qualifiers.sql_query:
SELECT 
    a.PROCESS_NAME, 
    a.ERROR_MESSAGE, 
    a.ERROR_DATE,
    a.PP_END_YEAR,
    a.PP_NUM,
    a.CYCLE_ID

FROM
    ERROR_TBL a,

    (SELECT
            b1.PP_END_YEAR,
            b1.PP_NUM,
            MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE,
	     MAX(b1.CYCLE_ID) as CYCLE_ID
    FROM
         ERROR_TBL b1
    WHERE
	   b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND
         b1.PP_END_YEAR = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_END_YEAR')
    AND
        b1.PP_NUM = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_NUM')
AND
	b1.CYCLE_ID = $$MAP_CYCLE_ID
    AND
        b1.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_0150_PM_FDA_Error_Counter'
    GROUP BY
        b1.PP_END_YEAR,
        b1.PP_NUM
    ) b

WHERE
	a.PP_END_YEAR = b.PP_END_YEAR
AND
	a.PP_NUM = b.PP_NUM
AND
	a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE
AND
	a.CYCLE_ID = b.CYCLE_ID
AND
    a.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_0150_PM_FDA_Error_Counter'
